name: 桂林
description: Guilin, 'Forest of Osmanthus', is famous for its stunning karst landscape of limestone peaks rising from the Li River. The city has been inspiring Chinese painters and poets for centuries with its ethereal scenery. Besides natural beauty, it offers cave explorations, cycling along the river, bamboo raft trips, and the vibrant Sun and Moon Pagodas.
highlights: Li River Cruise - Karst landscape from water
Reed Flute Cave - Rainbow-lit underground wonder
Longji Rice Terraces - Dragons backbone terraces

climate.tips: Best visited in spring and autumn. Summer is hot and humid with occasional flooding. Winter mild but can be foggy. 'Guilin rain' - frequent afternoon showers create misty scenery. Pack rain gear.

attractions.name: 七星公园
attractions.description: Guilin's largest park featuring seven peaks arranged like the Big Dipper constellation, with caves, ancient trees, and a small zoo.
attractions.address: 7 Star Rd, Guilin
attractions.tips: Best combined with a visit to the zoo if traveling with children.

attractions.name: 靖江王府
attractions.description: A 600-year-old Ming dynasty princely mansion and UNESCO World Heritage site, featuring ancient architecture and the famous GUILIN DOCUMENT.
attractions.address: 1 Wangcheng Rd, Guilin
attractions.tips: Morning visit recommended to avoid crowds. Audio guide included in ticket.

attractions.name: 东西巷
attractions.description: A renovated historical district near the city center combining traditional architecture with modern amenities, featuring local snacks and crafts.
attractions.address: Chongshan Rd, Guilin
attractions.tips: Best visited in evening when illuminated. Great for souvenirs and local snacks.

attractions.name: 十里画廊
attractions.description: A scenic cycling route in Yangshuo passing through rolling hills, rice paddies, and traditional villages with stunning karst views.
attractions.address: Yangshuo to Baisha, 20km route
attractions.tips: Rent e-bikes in Yangshuo. Start early morning for best light and fewer tourists. Stop at cafes along the route.

attractions.name: 遇龙河
attractions.description: A tributary of the Li River, famous for its peaceful bamboo raft rides through dramatic karst scenery away from the crowds.
attractions.address: Yulong Village, Yangshuo County
attractions.tips: Book through your hotel. Less crowded than Li River. Morning mists most beautiful. Bring sunscreen.

attractions.name: 叠彩山
attractions.description: A hill in northern Guilin with excellent views over the city, named for its layers of colored rock resembling folded silk.
attractions.address: Diecai Rd, Guilin
attractions.tips: Combine with Fubo Hill for a morning tour. Wear comfortable shoes. Best visited at sunrise for city views.

attractions.name: 拱极山
attractions.description: A small hill with a natural arch offering panoramic views of Guilin and the surrounding karst landscape.
attractions.address: Gongzhong Village, Guilin
attractions.tips: Less touristy spot favored by locals. Good for sunrise photography.

attractions.name: 尧山
attractions.description: The highest mountain near Guilin at 909m, offering cable car rides and stunning views of the karst landscape from above.
attractions.address: Yaoshan Town, 15km from Guilin
attractions.tips: Best visited on clear days. Summer best for flower sea. Winter for frost views.

attractions.name: 象山传奇
attractions.description: Evening light show and boat tour around Elephant Trunk Hill featuring 3D projection mapping and cultural performances.
attractions.address: Shanxian Rd, Guilin
attractions.tips: Book through hotel or online. Rain ponchos provided. Good weather essential for best experience.

attractions.name: 海洋银杏林
attractions.description: A vast ginkgo tree forest that turns golden yellow in autumn, creating stunning scenery contrasting with karst peaks.
attractions.address: Haiyang Town, 30km from Guilin
attractions.tips: Best visited mid-November. Weekends crowded. Combine with nearby villages.

attractions.name: 高田石窟
attractions.description: Ancient Buddhist cave temples dating back to Tang Dynasty, featuring colorful murals and sculptures carved into karst cliffs.
attractions.address: Gaotian Village, Yangshuo County
attractions.tips: Less crowded than other caves. Combine with cycling route to Ten Mile Gallery.

attractions.name: 刘三姐歌圩
attractions.description: An open-air venue on the Li River where visitors can experience traditional Guangxi folk songs and culture.
attractions.address: Lianhua Town, Yangshuo County
attractions.tips: Evening shows more lively. Interactive experience with performers.

attractions.name: 伏波山
attractions.description: A hill with a distinctive peak that juts out over the river, featuring ancient caves and excellent views of the city.
attractions.address: Fubo Rd, Guilin
attractions.tips: Combine with Diecai Mountain for morning tour. Wear comfortable shoes for climbing.

attractions.name: 漓江渔火
attractions.description: Traditional cormorant fishing demonstration on the Li River with lanterns and folk music.
attractions.address: Yangdi Village, 35km from Guilin
attractions.tips: Book evening tour including dinner. Best in summer. Bring warm jacket for evening.

attractions.name: 银子岩
attractions.description: A vast karst cave system known for its sparkling stalactites that resemble silver formations.
attractions.address: Maling Village, Yangshuo County, 80km from Guilin
attractions.tips: Combine with Yangshuo cycling. Follow guide for best photo spots. The cave is 2km long.

attractions.name: 龙脊平安寨
attractions.description: The most famous Zhuang village in the Longji Rice Terraces area with stunning views and authentic culture.
attractions.address: Ping'an Village, Longsheng County, 100km from Guilin
highlights: Nine Dragons, five tigers peering at ancient pines.
attractions.tips: Stay overnight for sunrise. Wear hiking shoes. Hire local guide. Try bamboo rice at village restaurants.

attractions.name: 龙脊古壮寨
attractions.description: Ancient Yao village with 400-year-old wooden architecture and authentic minority customs.
attractions.address: Dazhai Village, Longsheng County, 110km from Guilin
attractions.tips: Less touristy than Ping'an. Try Yao specialty dishes. Experience homemade rice wine.

attractions.name: 大圩古镇
attractions.description: A 1000-year-old Ming and Qing dynasty town on the Li River, once a major trading hub with preserved architecture.
attractions.address: Daxu Town, 15km from Guilin
attractions.tips: Best in early morning before tour buses. Try local specialties. Watch traditional crafts.

attractions.name: 阳朔西街
attractions.description: China's first 'foreigner street' with 1400 years of history, now a bustling pedestrian zone with shops and restaurants.
attractions.address: Chengzhong Rd, Yangshuo
attractions.tips: Avoid Golden Week. Explore side alleys for authentic shops. Try street food at night.

attractions.name: 象山公园
attractions.description: The iconic landmark of Guilin where an elephant drinks from the river with its trunk forming a natural arch.
attractions.address: Shanxian Rd, Guilin
attractions.tips: Best at sunset for reflection shots. The water view from Shanxian Rd is free. Buy ticket for inside access.

attractions.name: 芦笛岩
attractions.description: Guilin's most famous karst cave, named for the reeds that once grew at its entrance and were used to make flutes. Inside, stalactites in various shapes, illuminated by colorful lights, create a dreamlike scene, hailed as a natural art palace.
attractions.address: No. 1 Ludi Road, Xiufeng District, Guilin
attractions.tips: The cave maintains a constant temperature of 18°C year-round, cool in summer and warm in winter; a light jacket is recommended. Crowds are larger on weekends, so visiting on weekdays is advised.

attractions.name: 漓江游船
attractions.description: The 83-kilometer essence of the Li River from Guilin's Mopanshan Pier to Yangshuo, with towering peaks reflected in the water and lush bamboo groves along the banks, is the best interpretation of 'Guilin's scenery is the finest under heaven.'
attractions.address: From Mopanshan Wharf in Guilin to Yangshuo
attractions.tips: It is recommended to take a three-star or four-star cruise ship and purchase tickets one day in advance. The scenery is best on clear days.

attractions.name: 冠岩
attractions.description: A large karst cave that offers water, land, and air sightseeing options. Inside the cave, there is an underground river that can be explored by boat, and a small train that runs through it, making it very fun and interesting.
attractions.address: Caoping Township, Yanshan District, Guilin City
attractions.tips: It is recommended to wear non-slip shoes as the cave is quite damp. You can also combine a visit with Gudong Waterfall.

attractions.name: 古东瀑布
attractions.description: The only waterfall in China that can be climbed. Visitors can put on straw sandals and helmets and climb up along the waterfall, offering a fun and challenging water experience.
attractions.address: Gudong Village, Daxu Town, Lingchuan County, Guilin City
attractions.tips: It is recommended to wear water-resistant clothing and non-slip shoes. Bring a change of clothes.

attractions.name: 两江四湖
attractions.description: The ring-city water system in Guilin's urban area, consisting of the Li River, Taohua River, and Shan Lake, Rong Lake, Gui Lake, and Mulong Lake. Taking a night cruise offers views of attractions like the Sun and Moon Twin Towers.
attractions.address: Guilin's central ring-city water system
attractions.tips: The night cruise is more spectacular than the day cruise; it is recommended to purchase tickets in advance.

attractions.name: 兴坪古镇
attractions.description: An ancient town with a history of over 1,700 years along the Li River, featured on the back of the 20-yuan note. The town is well-preserved, with blue-stone streets and an ancient stage that are must-see experiences.
attractions.address: Xingping Town, Yangshuo County, Guilin City
highlights: Scenic spot featured on the 20-yuan note
attractions.tips: It is recommended to stay overnight in the ancient town; the Li River is most beautiful in the early morning and at dusk.

attractions.name: 相公山
attractions.description: An observation deck along the Li River, the best spot to photograph the first bend of the Li River. Climbing to the top in the early morning offers a magnificent view of the river's morning mist and fishing lights.
attractions.address: Xingping Town, Yangshuo County, Guilin City
highlights: First bend of the Li River
attractions.tips: Best to arrive before sunrise; you need to set off in the early morning. The mountain path is steep, so wear sports shoes.

attractions.name: 月亮山
attractions.description: A signature natural wonder of Yangshuo. At the top of the mountain there is a natural circular hole that looks like a bright moon hanging high. It takes about 20 minutes to climb to the hole, where you can overlook the pastoral scenery.
attractions.address: Gaotian Town, Yangshuo County, Guilin City
highlights: The end of the Ten-Mile Gallery
attractions.tips: You can combine it with a bike ride along the Ten-Mile Gallery. Rock climbing enthusiasts can try the climbing routes on Moon Hill.

attractions.name: 印象刘三姐
attractions.description: A large-scale open-air landscape performance directed by Zhang Yimou, using the Li River and twelve peaks as the natural stage, telling the legendary story of Liu Sanjie, the song fairy of the Zhuang ethnic group.
attractions.address: No. 1 Tianyuan Road, Yangshuo County, Guilin City
attractions.tips: It is recommended to buy seats in Zone B for the best value. The performance is outdoors and will go on as scheduled even in rain.

attractions.name: 独秀峰王城景区
attractions.description: A landmark attraction in downtown Guilin. Duxiu Peak rises abruptly, and from the top you can overlook the whole city. The Royal City is the former site of the Jingjiang Prince's Mansion from the Ming Dynasty, with a history of over 600 years.
attractions.address: No. 1 Wangcheng Road, Xiufeng District, Guilin
highlights: Climbing to the top of Duxiu Peak
attractions.tips: You can participate in an imperial examination experience and take photos in ancient costumes.

attractions.name: 灵渠
attractions.description: An ancient water conservancy project built during the Qin Dynasty, as famous as the Dujiangyan Irrigation System. It connects the Xiang River and the Li River, still playing an irrigation role today, showcasing the wisdom of ancient Chinese people.
attractions.address: Lingqu South Road, Xing'an County, Guilin City
attractions.tips: You can hire a guide to explain the principles of the water conservancy project. In spring, both banks are lush and green.

attractions.name: 龙胜温泉
attractions.description: A natural hot spring group located in Longsheng Various Nationalities Autonomous County, the spring water contains multiple minerals and has a constant temperature of 50°C all year round. Soaking in hot springs surrounded by mountains is a relaxing way after visiting the Longji Rice Terraces.
attractions.address: Jiangdi Township, Longsheng Various Nationalities Autonomous County, Guilin City
attractions.tips: It is recommended to go after visiting the Longji Rice Terraces. The best experience for hot springs is in winter.

attractions.name: 桂林美术馆
attractions.description: A professional art museum showcasing Guilin landscape paintings and contemporary artworks, with a rich collection and regular exhibitions and art exchange events.
attractions.address: No. 1 Shanhu North Road, Xiufeng District, Guilin City
attractions.tips: Exhibition themes change periodically; follow the official WeChat account for the latest updates.

attractions.name: 独秀峰公园
attractions.description: A city park centered around Duxiu Peak, featuring ancient trees and pavilions scattered in a picturesque layout, making it a great spot for residents to relax and exercise.
attractions.address: Duxiu Peak Road, Xiufeng District, Guilin City
attractions.tips: In the early morning, you can see residents practicing Tai Chi. Suitable for walking and relaxation.

attractions.name: 兴坪竹筏漂流
attractions.description: Take a bamboo raft ride along the Xingping section of the Li River to experience the beauty of the river and mountains up close. Along the way, enjoy classic sights such as Nine Horses Mural Hill and the Reflection of Yellow Cloth.
attractions.address: Xingping Town, Yangshuo County, Guilin City
attractions.tips: Children under 7 and seniors over 70 are not allowed to ride. Wear a life jacket.

attractions.name: 九仙山
attractions.description: A famous Taoist mountain in Yangshuo, with ancient structures like Jiuxian Pavilion on the summit. Climbing to the top offers panoramic views of the Li River and Yangshuo county town.
attractions.address: Yangshuo County, Guilin City
highlights: Panoramic view of the Li River
attractions.tips: It is recommended to hike up the mountain in the afternoon to watch the sunset. There are many steps, so wear comfortable sports shoes.

attractions.name: 桂林动物园
attractions.description: Located in Seven Star Park, this zoo houses rare animals such as giant pandas, golden snub-nosed monkeys, and South China tigers. It is a great place for family trips.
attractions.address: No. 1 Qixing Road, Qixing District, Guilin City
attractions.ticketPrice: Included in the Seven Star Park ticket
attractions.tips: It is recommended to visit together with Seven Star Park.

attractions.name: 杨堤风光
attractions.description: A small village on the Li River, one of the starting points for Li River rafting. Surrounded by mountains and bamboo groves, it is an excellent spot for photographing the sunrise and fishing lights on the Li River.
attractions.address: Yangdi Township, Lingchuan County, Guilin City
attractions.tips: Arrive in the early morning to capture the morning mist over the Li River. You can take a shuttle bus from downtown Guilin to get there.

attractions.name: 八角寨
attractions.description: A Danxia landform scenic area in Ziyuan County, named after the eight upturned peaks on the main mountain. When the mountaintop is shrouded in clouds and mist, the eight peaks emerge from the sea of clouds, earning it the reputation as the soul of Danxia.
attractions.address: Meixi Township, Ziyuan County, Guilin City
attractions.tips: It's recommended to get up early to see the sea of clouds. The mountain paths are steep, so wear hiking shoes.

attractions.name: 资江漂流
attractions.description: The Zijiang River rafting in Ziyuan County features clear, emerald waters and colorful Danxia landforms along the banks. It is hailed as the best rafting in China.
attractions.address: Ziyuan County, Guilin City
attractions.tips: Can be combined with a visit to the Danxia landforms of Bajiao Village. Wear sun-protective clothing.

attractions.name: 五排河漂流
attractions.description: Known as the best rafting in Guilin, with swift currents and dense primeval forests on both banks. It is one of the most thrilling rafting experiences in Guangxi.
attractions.address: Ziyuan County, Guilin City
attractions.tips: Open only in summer (May-October). Bring a change of clothes and wear sandals.

attractions.name: 桂林乐满地
attractions.description: A comprehensive tourist resort integrating a theme park, golf course, and resort hotel, featuring various rides and performances.
attractions.address: Xing'an County, Guilin City
attractions.tips: Suitable for families with children. The water park is open in summer.

attractions.name: 江头洲古村
attractions.description: An ancient village with a history of over 600 years, featuring well-preserved Ming and Qing dynasty architectural complexes. The village, with its blue bricks, gray tiles, and stone-paved alleys, is a settlement of Zhou Dunyi's descendants and is renowned as the 'Village of Honest Officials' for its centuries-old legacy.
attractions.address: Jiangtouzhou Village, Jiuwu Town, Lingchuan County, Guilin City
attractions.tips: Few tourists, ideal for travelers who love ancient villages. Accessible by self-driving or chartered car.

attractions.name: 桂林茶文化博物馆
attractions.description: A themed museum showcasing Chinese tea culture and the history of local Guilin tea. Visitors can taste local famous teas such as Liubao tea and osmanthus tea.
attractions.address: Xiufeng District, Guilin City
attractions.tips: You can sample a variety of local Guilin teas for free. A great place to buy tea as souvenirs.

attractions.name: 普陀山
attractions.description: A peak within Seven Star Park, named for enshrining Guanyin Bodhisattva. It features Buddhist structures like Puxu Monastery, and from the summit you can overlook the urban area of Guilin.
attractions.address: Within Seven Star Park, Qixing District, Guilin City
attractions.ticketPrice: Included in the Seven Star Park ticket
attractions.tips: Visit together with Seven Star Park. The mountain path is gentle, suitable for all ages.

attractions.name: 会仙湿地
attractions.description: Guilin Karst Wetland Park, one of China's largest karst wetlands. Paddy fields, lotus ponds, and karst peaks interweave, making it a great place for birdwatching and photographing pastoral scenery.
attractions.address: Huixian Town, Lingui District, Guilin
attractions.tips: In summer, the lotus flowers are at their most beautiful. It is more convenient to drive there. There are many mosquitoes, so take precautions against them.

attractions.name: 阳朔徐悲鸿故居
attractions.description: The former residence of the famous painter Xu Beihong in Yangshuo, showcasing his life and works during his creative period in Guilin. The building itself is also a typical folk house from the Republic of China era.
attractions.address: Xianqian Street, Yangshuo County, Guilin
attractions.tips: It is near West Street in Yangshuo, so you can visit it on the way. It is not large but worth a look.

attractions.name: 草坪回族乡
attractions.description: A Hui ethnic village along the Li River, where you can experience Hui culture and halal cuisine. The village's mosque is simple and elegant, making it a great place to learn about Guilin's diverse ethnic culture.
attractions.address: Caoping Township, Yanshan District, Guilin City
attractions.tips: Respect the dietary habits of the Hui people. You can try the local halal beef noodles.

attractions.name: 漓江国家公园
attractions.description: A national scenic area centered on the Li River, covering the essence of the scenery along both banks from Guilin to Yangshuo. The park features beautiful mountains and waters, peculiar caves and stunning rocks, serving as a concentrated display of Guilin's landscapes.
attractions.address: Lingchuan County to Yangshuo County, Guilin
highlights: The essence of the Li River
attractions.tips: It is recommended to set aside a full day for sightseeing. You can hike the essence of the Li River from Yangdi to Xingping.

attractions.name: 石头城
attractions.description: An ancient stone village in Putao Town, Yangshuo County, built entirely of stone, with well-preserved stone houses, stone walls, and stone-paved roads. It is a must-visit spot for photography enthusiasts and art lovers.
attractions.address: Putao Town, Yangshuo County, Guilin City
attractions.tips: Fewer tourists, suitable for travelers who prefer quiet. Accessible by self-driving or cycling.

culturalTips.title: Minority Cultures
culturalTips.content: Guilin area home to Zhuang, Yao, and other minority groups. Longji Rice Terraces are farmed by Zhuang and Yao people. Respect local customs when visiting villages.

culturalTips.title: Weather and Photography
culturalTips.content: Misty weather creates the classic Guilin scenery - don't be disappointed by 'bad' weather. Early morning and evening light most magical. Rain creates mist and reflections.

culturalTips.title: Yangshuo Cycling
culturalTips.content: Cycling is the best way to explore Yangshuo's countryside. Rent e-bikes (50¥/day) and explore back roads. Follow rice paddies and karst peaks. Return before dark.

culturalTips.title: Yangshuo Escape
culturalTips.content: The Li River cruise to Yangshuo is magical but crowded. Consider staying overnight in Yangshuo and exploring by bike. The Western Street comes alive at night with hundreds of food stalls. Travelers from around the world gather here.

culturalTips.title: Li River History
culturalTips.content: The Li River has been a source of artistic inspiration for over 1000 years. Many famous Chinese paintings and poems depict its karst scenery. The river was once a major transportation route connecting Guangxi with the outside world.

culturalTips.title: Zhuang Culture
culturalTips.content: The Zhuang people are China's largest minority ethnic group. Their traditional Brocade weaving and folk songs (Ge Xiao) are famous throughout China. The Zhuang New Year (Spring Festival) is celebrated with unique customs including water splashing.

culturalTips.title: Yao People
culturalTips.content: The Yao people are known for their Red Detachment of Women costume and traditional Panwang Festival. Women traditionally wear their hair long - some Yao women never cut their hair and wrap it in elaborate coils. Longji villages are authentic Yao communities.

culturalTips.title: Karst Landscape Formation
culturalTips.content: Guilin's karst landscape formed over millions of years as rainwater dissolved limestone bedrock. The same geological process created the caves, underground rivers, and natural bridges. Reed Flute Cave stalactites are estimated to be 450,000 years old.

culturalTips.title: City Name Origin
culturalTips.content: Guilin means 'Forest of Osmanthus' in Chinese. The city is famous for its osmanthus trees which bloom in autumn, filling the air with sweet fragrance. The osmanthus flower is also used in local cuisine - cakes, tea, and wine.

culturalTips.title: Traditional Cormorant Fishing
culturalTips.content: The ancient technique of fishing with trained cormorants is still practiced on the Li River. Fishermen use bamboo rafts and allow cormorants to dive for fish. A ring around the bird's neck prevents them from swallowing large fish.

culturalTips.title: Terrace Farming
culturalTips.content: The Longji Rice Terraces were carved over 600 years by hand, following the contour lines of the mountains. Local farmers still plant rice using traditional methods. Water flows down from the mountains, creating a natural irrigation system.

culturalTips.title: Liu Sanjie Legend
culturalTips.content: Liu Sanjie (Third Sister Liu) is a legendary Zhuang folk singer whose songs have been passed down for centuries. The famous 'Impression Liu Sanjie' outdoor show by Zhang Yimou is set on the Li River where the legend takes place.

culturalTips.title: Guilin Cuisine
culturalTips.content: Guilin cuisine is known for its use of chili peppers, sour flavors, and fresh ingredients. Signature dishes include Guilin rice noodles, beer fish, and various pork preparations. The city is also famous for osmanthus-flavored sweets.

culturalTips.title: Moon Hill Mystery
culturalTips.content: Moon Hill is a natural arch formed by karst erosion, creating a perfect moon shape when viewed from certain angles. The arch is 410m above ground level. Local legend says it was formed by the goddess Chang'e visiting the area.

culturalTips.title: Bamboo Raft History
culturalTips.content: Bamboo rafts have been used on the Li River for over 1000 years as the primary transportation method. Today, they serve mainly tourism but the design remains traditional. A typical raft uses 5-7 bamboo poles lashed together.

culturalTips.title: Cave Systems
culturalTips.content: Guilin has one of the largest concentrations of karst caves in China, with over 1000 explored. Reed Flute Cave (Ludi Yan) is the most famous, with stalactites illuminated in rainbow colors. Other notable caves include Silver Cave and Gongzhong Cave.

culturalTips.title: Best Photography Spots
culturalTips.content: For classic Guilin shots: Elephant Trunk Hill at sunrise, Longji terraces at golden hour, Yulong River bamboo rafts in morning mist. The 20 RMB note features Elephant Trunk Hill and the Five-Hundred-Bhon Temple.

culturalTips.title: Guilin Tea Culture
culturalTips.content: Lipu tea and Gulong tea are famous local varieties. Tea houses are popular gathering spots. The traditional tea ceremony involves multiple infusions, each with different flavor notes. Tea is often served with osmanthus cakes.

culturalTips.title: Guilin Tea Ceremony
culturalTips.content: Traditional Guangxi tea ceremony involves 'Gongfu Cha' with multiple infusions. Tea houses near Elephant Hill serve osmanthus tea alongside the view. The tea culture here combines Zhuang and Han traditions.

culturalTips.title: Zhuang Water Splashing Festival
culturalTips.content: The Zhuang New Year includes the Water Splashing Festival, where locals splash each other and visitors with water for blessing. Spring is the main season. Joining is acceptable - expect to get wet!

culturalTips.title: Bamboo Raft Photography Tips
culturalTips.content: For the best bamboo raft photos, go early morning when mist rises. The Yulong River bamboo rafts are more scenic than Li River. Wear a hat and sunscreen - there's no shade. Cameras should be protected from splashes.

culturalTips.title: Best Seasons for Rice Terraces
culturalTips.content: Longji terraces look different each season: water-filled in spring (April-May), green in summer, golden in autumn (September-October), snowy in winter. Spring is most dramatic but wet. Autumn is most popular.

culturalTips.title: Yangshuo English Level
culturalTips.content: Yangshuo has the highest concentration of English speakers outside major cities in China. Many restaurant menus have English. Market vendors use calculators for prices. Still, learning 'hello' and 'how much' is appreciated.

culturalTips.title: Bamboo Shoot Season
culturalTips.content: Fresh bamboo shoots are a spring delicacy in Guilin. They're harvested from March to May and appear in many local dishes. Try sour bamboo shoots - an acquired taste. They're also sold dried year-round.

culturalTips.title: Li River Cruise Tips
culturalTips.content: The classic 4-hour cruise from Zhujiang to Yangshuo passes iconic scenery. Book upper deck for best views. Lunch included on board. Evening cruises available for sunset. Bring layers - river can be cold.

culturalTips.title: Zhuang Language and Customs
culturalTips.content: The Zhuang language is tonal and different from Mandarin. Their folk songs 'Ge Xiao' are UNESCO intangible heritage. When visiting Zhuang homes, remove shoes at door. Tipping head chef shows respect. 'Gai' means 'chicken' in Zhuang dialect.

culturalTips.title: Karst Cave Safety
culturalTips.content: Guilin's caves are cool year-round (15-18C). Wear layers and comfortable shoes. Paths can be slippery. Watch your head on low stalactites. The 'Lightning Tower' in Silver Cave is 26m high. Photography restricted in some areas.

culturalTips.title: Osmanthus Blossom Festival
culturalTips.content: Guilin's osmanthus trees bloom in late September to early October, filling the city with sweet fragrance. The Osmanthus Festival includes cultural performances, tea ceremonies, and osmanthus-themed foods. Book accommodation early for this period.

culturalTips.title: Yangshuo Nightlife Scene
culturalTips.content: Yangshuo has a surprisingly vibrant nightlife for its size. West Street has live music bars, rooftop pubs, and foreign-owned cafes. The 'Impression Liu Sanjie' show starts at 20:00. Karaoke and bar hopping are popular among locals.

culturalTips.title: Fishing Village Life
culturalTips.content: Life in Yangshuo's fishing villages along the river remains traditional. Cormorant fishing, bamboo rafts, and net mending are daily activities. Some families offer homestays - a chance to experience authentic river life. Early morning is most photogenic.

culturalTips.title: E-Bike Rental in Yangshuo
culturalTips.content: Rent e-bikes at shops along West Street (30-50¥/day). No license needed for under-50cc vehicles. Follow traffic rules - bikes stay right. Helmet recommended but not always available. Return before dark as roads unlit.

culturalTips.title: River Fish Preparation Methods
culturalTips.content: Guilin's river fish (carp, grass carp) are prepared in various ways: 'beer fish' (braised with tomato and beer), 'Lijiang steamed fish', 'charcoal-grilled fish'. Ask for 'less spicy' if needed. Freshness is guaranteed in riverside restaurants.
